profile: packaged debug app with optimized first-party crates, real background WKWebView, scripted manual refresh/interaction; not foreground rendering or GPU/JS-heap measurement; no provider/network or cross-product comparison
attribution: Native RSS is exact PID. WebKit RSS includes new WebKit helpers absent before launch; XPC parentage cannot exclude unrelated helpers launched during the interval. Git RSS is sampled descendants only and can miss short-lived peaks. Summed RSS may double-count shared pages; it is not JS heap or total GPU allocation.
idle_sleep_guard: Temporary task-owned caffeinate -i tied to native PID; no display/lock settings changed
